name: Sentry
tagline: Look into errors and slowdowns in your apps, and triage issues.
summary: Search and read the user's Sentry: issues, errors, stack traces, traces, logs, replays and releases, and ask Seer for a root cause. Issues are resolved, assigned or commented on, and projects or alerts changed, only after the user approves.
can: Search issues, errors, traces, logs and replays, and read stack traces
Find an issue's root cause, with Sentry's Seer on plans that have it
Resolve, assign or comment on an issue, or change alerts, only after you approve it
